brief:
UN special rapporteur on the occupied Palestinian territories Francesca Albanese has left Costa Rica after authorities denied her entry and held her for two nights, Middle East Eye reported. Albanese, who investigates human rights violations in Palestinian territories, was detained upon arrival at the country's border.

The circumstances surrounding her denial of entry were not immediately clear. Albanese's expulsion marks a rare instance of a UN rights official being prevented from entering a country.
